title: Signal and Colony
author: Lior Sandoval
blurb: Casper Crane, a terraformer tending a garden meant for people not yet born, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. But when an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
